slide-0-cover.png.prompt:
Create one finished 4:5 portrait GainFrame Guy fitness comic. Image 1 is the approved current style: copy its lean-athletic charcoal body, olive shorts, taupe trainers, clean two-tone cel shading, mascot size in the frame, light grounded gym background (racks, plates, bench in soft grey) and small pale blue/lavender washes. Image 2 is the exact face only: FOUR SEPARATE floating L scan-frame corners, three black and the lower-right red, open WHITE interior, large asymmetric left eye connected to a sweeping S curve, small right eye. Never a filled head, helmet or plush; no extra mouth or bracket inside the face. Moderate shoulders and arms, smaller chest, natural waist, no bodybuilder bulk. Exactly two arms, two hands with five fingers each, two legs; uniform charcoal skin on both hands. White covers at least 75% of the canvas; no red streak. Crisp comic linework, grounded neutral equipment drawn with correct mechanics. Impact/Bebas bold titles and Helvetica body text. All requested text verbatim, no extra copy. Do not copy any words from the reference images.

COVER. Small "GAINFRAME GUY" wordmark badge (face icon plus the two words) at the top-left, same style and size as image 1. Broad empty white band below the badge. Main headline in THREE short centered lines, all letters between 19% and 38% of the canvas height and inside the central 70% of the width, no banner or shape behind it:
"YOUR SHOULDER PRESS" with "SHOULDER PRESS" in red #E53935
"STARTS AT" in near-black
"THE BENCH" in near-black
Scene starts below 42% height and fits inside the canvas: GainFrame Guy stands confidently beside an adjustable bench whose backrest is set almost upright, one hand resting on top of the backrest, the other hand empty and relaxed. A pair of hex dumbbells rests on the floor beside the bench. Soft grey gym background like image 1.
